# nullplatform_artifact (Data Source)

Looks up a platform artifact (and one of its revisions) VISIBLE at the given nrn — owned there, shared by an ancestor, or published globally with "organization=*" — by its meta fields: e.g. a git_repository by { url, reference } or an OCI image by { registry, repository, digest }. Identity fields select the artifact; per-revision fields (digest, reference, tag) select a revision, otherwise the latest is used. Selecting by tag resolves the NEWEST revision carrying that tag and computes its digest — when the tag is re-registered against a new digest, the data source drifts to the new revision by design. Read-only: never registers anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve a git repository artifact revision by url + reference — the ids are
# ready to pin in a package BOM.
data "nullplatform_artifact" "scopes_at_1_10" {
  nrn  = "organization=1255165411:account=95118862"
  type = "git_repository"
  meta = jsonencode({
    url       = "https://github.com/nullplatform/scopes.git"
    reference = "1.10.0"
  })
}

# Identity-only lookup: resolves the artifact and its latest revision.
data "nullplatform_artifact" "scopes_latest" {
  nrn  = "organization=1255165411:account=95118862"
  type = "git_repository"
  meta = jsonencode({
    url = "https://github.com/nullplatform/scopes.git"
  })
}

output "scopes_revision_id" {
  value = data.nullplatform_artifact.scopes_at_1_10.revision_id
}

# Tag-based lookup: resolve an OCI image by its human-readable tag instead of
# a digest — the data source finds the NEWEST revision registered with that
# tag and computes its digest for you. When the tag is re-registered against a
# new image, the next plan drifts to the new revision (digest changes), by design.
data "nullplatform_artifact" "worker_v1" {
  nrn  = "organization=1255165411:account=95118862"
  type = "oci_image"
  meta = jsonencode({
    registry   = "public.ecr.aws"
    repository = "nullplatform/scopes/lambda"
    tag        = "v1.2.0"
  })
}

output "worker_pinned_reference" {
  value = "public.ecr.aws/nullplatform/scopes/lambda@${data.nullplatform_artifact.worker_v1.digest}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `meta` (String) JSON object with the meta fields to match. Identity fields (e.g. url, registry+repository) select the artifact; per-revision fields (e.g. reference, digest, tag) additionally select a specific revision. A tag resolves to the newest revision registered with it.
- `nrn` (String) The NRN to resolve visibility from: matches artifacts owned there, shared by ancestors, and globals (organization=*).
- `type` (String) The artifact type.

### Read-Only

- `artifact_id` (String) The artifact (envelope) id — use as a BOM component's `resource_id`.
- `digest` (String) The resolved revision's content digest (sha256:…), when its meta carries one — the pinnable value a tag-based lookup resolves for you.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `latest_revision_id` (String) The artifact's most recent revision id.
- `revision_id` (String) The resolved revision id — use as a BOM component's `resource_revision_id`.
- `revision_meta` (String) JSON object with the full meta blob of the resolved revision.
- `visible_to` (List of String) NRNs allowed to consume this artifact.
